quote: untrue statements of material fact and unsubstantiated statements of material fact
finding: Examined advisers published untrue or unsubstantiated statements of material fact.
practice: Substantiate every material claim before publication and keep the substantiation with the approved advertisement.

quote: omission of material facts or misleading inference
finding: Examined advisers omitted material facts or let an advertisement imply something misleading.
practice: Review what the post implies as well as what it states, including an endorser's claim about returns.

quote: fair and balanced treatment of material risks or limitations
finding: Examined advisers presented benefits without fair and balanced treatment of material risks or limitations.
practice: Pair every stated benefit with its material risks in the same medium as the claim.

quote: references to specific investment advice that were not presented in a fair and balanced manner
finding: Examined advisers referenced specific investment advice in a way that was not fair and balanced.
practice: Do not let an endorser single out winning recommendations without the context the rule requires.

quote: inclusion or exclusion of performance results or time period in matters that were not fair and balanced
finding: Examined advisers chose performance results or time periods in a way that was not fair and balanced.
practice: Show performance over the periods the rule requires and never let an endorser quote a cherry-picked result.

finding: Examined advisers' written marketing policies and procedures were not reasonably designed or implemented.
practice: Keep a written standard that covers every channel you use, social media included, and test that it is followed.

finding: Examined advisers did not keep the marketing records the Books and Records Rule requires.
practice: Retain every advertisement and its approval, including posts on social media.

quote: Marketing Rule items contained in Form ADV
finding: Examined advisers completed the Marketing Rule items in Form ADV inaccurately.
practice: Report testimonials, endorsements and paid promoters accurately in Form ADV.
